candidate.raw_translation: Wannan tebur na farawa na cikin gida yana amfani da hana sakewa na wuri da kuma sakamako na yanki mai sauki: duwatsu tare da yankuna bacci da aka rufe da launin daya. Bã ya amfani da komi, haƙƙoƙi, agogo na gasar kwallon ƙafa, hukuncin rayuwa da mutuwa ko kuma kowane bambanci na ƙungiyoyin ƙa'idodi. Mutum biyu suna raba wannan na'ura; ba a karɓa ko kiyaye motsa-motsa ba.
candidate.source: This local beginner board uses positional repetition prevention and simple area scoring: stones plus empty regions bordered by one color. It does not apply komi, handicap, tournament clocks, life-and-death adjudication or every ruleset variation. Two people share this device; moves are not uploaded or saved.
